<p>In <a href="/logs/logpush/logpush-job/datasets/zone/http_requests/">HTTP request logs</a>, <code>cacheResponseBytes</code> reflects the uncompressed response size from cache or origin. <code>edgeResponseBytes</code> reflects the final compressed response size sent to the client. Because Cloudflare applies compression (gzip, Brotli) before delivering to the client, <code>edgeResponseBytes</code> is typically smaller than <code>cacheResponseBytes</code>.</p>
